dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Strongly falcate trailing edge characterized by a deep concave curve extending from the sub-apex region to the posterior dorsal insertion.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius; lacks acute termination.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Steep, approximately 55-degree linear incline relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.4:1 ratio of the visible base length to the maximum vertical height.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Minor irregular crenulations and nicks present along the trailing edge margin; small white punctate depigmentation marks visible on the lateral fin surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive white linear marking along the upper portion of the trailing edge just below the apex.
